examples.text: 请再次确认明天的航班时间。
examples.trans: Please confirm tomorrow's flight time again.

meanings.note: Singer under contract with the show or label.

examples.text: 参加明晚总决赛的签约歌手已经全部到齐了。
examples.trans: All signed singers for tomorrow's finale have arrived.

examples.text: 唱片公司正在为几位新签约歌手录制专辑。
examples.trans: The label is recording albums for several newly signed singers.

examples.text: 这是组啊。
examples.trans: This is team.

examples.text: 那个组好。
examples.trans: That team is good.

meanings.note: Used as noun or verb for testing staff readiness.

examples.text: 所有现场工作人员都已经通过了应急培训考核。
examples.trans: Every on-site crew member passed the emergency training check.

examples.text: 公司每年年底都会对各部门进行业务考核。
examples.trans: At year's end the company evaluates every department.

meanings.note: Checking performers' records before broadcast approval.

examples.text: 所有上台嘉宾都已经完成了严格的背景调查。
examples.trans: Every stage guest has cleared a thorough background check.

examples.text: 入职核心岗位之前通常需要做一次背景调查。
examples.trans: Joining a core post usually requires a routine background check.

examples.text: 我们的艺人方案特别重要，不能泄露！
examples.trans: Our guest-artist plan is especially important; it must not leak!

examples.text: 这是艺人。
examples.trans: This is 艺人.

examples.text: 你需要吃药。
examples.trans: You need to take medicine.

examples.text: 这药很苦。
examples.trans: This medicine is very bitter.

蓝色预警.gloss: blue weather alert (lowest tier of storm warning)

meanings.en: blue weather alert (lowest tier of storm warning)
meanings.note: Initial caution tier in China's four-colour weather alert system.

examples.text: 气象台早间发布了大风和降雨的蓝色预警。
examples.trans: This morning the weather bureau issued a blue alert for wind and rain.

examples.text: 虽然只是蓝色预警，户外搭建还是得做好防雨措施。
examples.trans: Even under a blue alert, outdoor staging needs rain protection.

examples.text: 我觉得还是让她来讲解一下比较好。
examples.trans: I think it would be better to have her explain it.

examples.text: 我觉得还是让她来讲解一下比较好。
examples.trans: I think it would be better to have her explain it.

examples.text: 你也不用太悲观了，可以试试云海卫视。
examples.trans: You do not need to be too pessimistic either; you can try Yunhai Television.

examples.text: 这是试试。
examples.trans: This is 试试.

examples.text: 你敢说你不是为了他，放弃到手的金饭碗？
examples.trans: Translation.

meanings.note: Stage/TV term for walking through cues, marks, and lighting.

examples.text: 助演嘉宾下午已经在演播厅顺利完成了走台。
examples.trans: The guest performers finished stage blocking in the studio this afternoon.

examples.text: 正式开录之前，所有歌手必须按顺序走台一次。
examples.trans: Before taping starts, every singer must walk their stage marks once.

meanings.note: Mobile control-room truck transmitting live television feeds.

examples.text: 院子里停着三辆大型高清电视转播车。
examples.trans: Three large HD broadcast trucks are parked in the courtyard.

examples.text: 工程师已经完成了全部转播车的信号检修。
examples.trans: Engineers have completed signal checks on every broadcast truck.

examples.text: 这些资料，还有这四百个小时的录像资料。
examples.trans: These files, plus these four hundred hours of video recordings.

examples.text: 这是还有。
examples.trans: Translation.

examples.trans: Whose is this?

examples.trans: Do you trust me this much?

examples.text: 这是这么。
examples.trans: Translation.

examples.text: 星天有很多部门，这些部门之间都是平行的。
examples.trans: Xingtian has many departments, and all of these departments are on equal footing.

meanings.note: Dedicated lodging compound for show contestants during finals.

examples.text: 所有参赛歌手今晚统一住在封闭管理的选手村。
examples.trans: All competing singers are staying at the contestant village tonight.

examples.text: 大巴车每天早上准时从选手村接歌手去演播厅。
examples.trans: Shuttles pick singers up from the contestant village every morning.

examples.text: 他不能再上其他的节目，只能取消通告。
examples.trans: He cannot appear on any other shows, so we can only cancel the booking.

examples.text: 这是通告。

examples.trans: That would be wonderful, thank you!

examples.trans: Over there — how about I take you over?

examples.text: 这是那边。
examples.trans: Translation.

examples.text: 不要太着急了，招聘竞争都很激烈。
examples.trans: Do not get too anxious; the hiring competition is very fierce.

examples.text: 这是都。

examples.text: 我想问一下，方教授在哪办公啊？
examples.trans: May I ask where Professor Fang has his office?

examples.trans: No problem, Professor.

examples.text: 这是问题。
examples.trans: This is 问题.

集体待命.gloss: stand by together as a group

meanings.en: stand by together as a group
meanings.note: All performers or crew waiting ready in one place.

examples.text: 全体参赛歌手已经抵达后台，正在休息室集体待命。
examples.trans: All competing singers have arrived backstage and are standing by together.

examples.text: 为了应对突发降雨，工程组在场外集体待命。
examples.trans: To handle sudden rain, the engineering crew stood by together outside.

examples.text: 看这云层不厚，今晚这场雨应该下不大。
examples.trans: With clouds this thin, tonight's rain probably will not get heavy.

examples.text: 下班的时候外面突然下起了瓢泼大雨，雨真大。
examples.trans: Right at quitting time it suddenly started pouring rain outside.
